name: tombstone_survives_prune
invariant: INV-5 — a delete is never silently lost to retention
notes: A delete journals with op `delete` (the tombstone). After a retention pass drops the old row and raises `pruned_up_to`, a follower whose cursor sits below the mark is told `resync_required` rather than being handed a journal with a silent hole — the resync re-reads the snapshot whose `tombstones` table still carries the delete. This vector pins the journal half of that guarantee.
